effects_provenance.raw: Blue Nerds THCA Flower Essential / 28g Strain Profile Blue Nerds THCA Flower is an award-winning hybrid bred for both flavor character and balanced effects. The buds carry vibrant blue-purple expression with a candy-sweet aromatic top note — visually distinct and structurally premium, the kind of cultivar that earns shelf space on looks alone. Effects Blue Nerds delivers a balanced, focus-friendly high that pairs calming euphoria with light energizing lift. The cerebral side stays clear and creative without anxious tension; the body baseline relaxes without becoming heavy — making this a strong daytime productivity cultivar that doesn't slow you down. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet berry-candy up front, with sugary citrus-fruit notes through the middle and a clean, slightly tangy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably dessert-leaning. The terpene profile reads candy-fruit with bright top notes — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Nerds harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blue Nerds THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blue Nerds THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. THCA: 23.941% Delta-9 THC: 0.2442% Berry Citrus hybrid Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation
